title: Fix UV mapping on CSGSphere
body:
Currently, UV mapping of:
![EarthClouds2000](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9253928/120080828-7a176f80-c0b2-11eb-8dc6-c200377cff0d.png)
is:
![43544-Current](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9253928/120080842-86033180-c0b2-11eb-9cfb-816276091f0c.png)
With this PR:
![43544-Fixed](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9253928/120080849-8c91a900-c0b2-11eb-91d7-ffb9ee9bce7e.png)
Fixes #43544.
